checks.text: A box price typed by mistake is refused, and the message says a taka price is for one piece and what the printed piece price is
A fixed taka price typed per piece works (8.2 per piece gives 246 for a box)

shots.caption: Typing a fixed taka price for this shop on Napa 500 mg
Typed 250, a box price, into the "Taka price per piece" box: the system explains the mistake
Typing a fixed taka price for this shop on Napa 500 mg
Typed 8.2 as the price of one piece: the box is now 246

did: Gave the shop a fixed taka price on Napa 500 mg. First typed 250, thinking of the price of a box. Then typed 8.2, the price of one piece.
